reactive_sites: All five carbon atoms,and only those atoms,are eligible equivalent-trajectory first-event sites. Group sites by shortest-path bond distance to the ring nitrogen.
model: A stipulated low-conversion parallel first-event model assigns the SAME per-site pseudo-first-order rate r_dto every carbon in graph-distance class d. Class hazard equals its site multiplicity times r_d;the total hazard and molar first-product fractions are measured. No secondary event or class-dependent product detection occurs. Relative per-site activation free energy against class1is -RT*ln(r_d/r_1),assuming the same prefactor. Graph symmetry supplies multiplicity only;it does not prove equal chemical reactivity of different classes.
target: Determine class multiplicities from the actual parent graph. Return absolute per-site rates and relative per-site activation free energies in class order,the fastest per-site class distance,and whether equal per-site rates reproduce the observed class product fractions.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled chemical model/exact observations;no empirical mechanism or practical reaction recommendation is inferred.
